data.title: Best Buy also among companies benefiting from AI boom
data.description: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi  looks at Best Buy's (BBY) strongest comparable sales growth in five years as a sign that AI demand is reaching consumers' wallets through device upgrades, and not showing up through data-center spending on Nvidia (NVDA), Microsoft (MSFT), and Amazon (AMZN).
